## MCP - LLM Summarizer

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/llm-summarizer

**Description:** Summarizes text using multiple LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral).

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["text"],
  "properties": {
    "text": { "type": "string", "description": "Text to summarize (required)" },
    "user_request": { "type": "string", "description": "User request context for personalized summary" },
    "provider": { "type": "string", "description": "LLM provider: anthropic (default), openai, mistral" },
    "format": { "type": "string", "description": "Output format: bullet-points, paragraph, executive-summary" },
    "max_tokens": { "type": "integer", "description": "Max output tokens (default: 1024)" },
    "user_id": { "type": "string", "description": "User ID for tracing" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string", "description": "Guild ID for tracing" }
  }
}
```

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": false,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["summary", "original_length", "summary_length"],
  "domain": "nlp"
}
```
